Name: Hats and Horns
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
This mod adds a bunch of new headwear for your farmer, some are animated and/or colorable.

[img=center]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/17405/17405-1689515626-520493503.png[/img]
[u][b]Ladies' Hats:[/b][/u]

* Flamboyant Hat (Colorable)
* Dark Rose Hat
* Stargazer Hat
* Ribbon Straw Hat (Ribbons animated & colorable)
* Pillbox Hats (Round, Angled, Bow, all are colorable)
* Bear Straw Hat

[img=center]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/17405/17405-1689515630-761613372.png[/img]
[u][b]Fantasy Hats:[/b][/u]

* Wood Elf Antlers (Flowers colorable)
* Small Flowery Antlers
* Laurels (Golden, Small)
* Mermaid Headband (Colorable)
* Seashell Tiara (Colorable)
* Coral Headdresses ( Bubblegum, Flame)

[img=center]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/17405/17405-1689515627-427623395.png[/img]
[u][b]Funky Hats:[/b][/u]

* Cathulhu Hat (Animated)
* Magikarp Hat
* Bulbasaur

[img=center]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/17405/17405-1689515630-1930484197.png[/img]
[u][b]Witchy Mushroom Hats:[/b][/u]

* Mushroom Hat (Brown)
* Witchy Hat (Mossy)
* Mushroom Hat (Red)
* Witchy Hat (Horn)
* Witchy Hat (Vines, colorable)


Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url].
Check out my other mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/147754183?tab=user+files]PlatinumCats mods[/url]
